name: Malice-Furnace
geological_features: A single super-continent cracked into tectonic plates in real time
Magma oceans covering forty percent of the surface
Volcanic lightning storms of extraordinary intensity
specific_features: Metallic structures detected beneath the magma ocean, consistent with artificial construction
description: Malice-Furnace is a large volcanic world dominated by a single super-continent that is actively tearing itself apart, its tectonic plates grinding and separating in geological processes visible on a human timescale. Magma oceans fill the widening rifts, and volcanic lightning storms crackle across the tortured sky with bolts that strike the same points thousands of times per hour.

The atmosphere is a toxic brew so dense with particulates that it functions almost as a liquid at lower altitudes, a choking orange fog lit from within by constant electrical discharge. The planet seems to act with deliberate hostility, its eruptions and storms targeting survey probes with a consistency that statisticians find troubling.

Deep-penetrating radar has revealed metallic structures beneath the magma ocean, arranged in geometric patterns consistent with artificial construction on a massive scale. Whatever built them possessed materials science far beyond current capability, as the structures remain intact at temperatures and pressures that would liquefy any known alloy.

The combination of rich mineral deposits and buried technology has made Malice-Furnace a priority target for multiple competing factions, none of whom have solved the fundamental problem of operating on a world that seems to actively resist investigation. Three orbital stations have been lost to volcanic ejecta launched with what analysts reluctantly describe as precision targeting.
